Five v1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial release featuring a bilingual (Chinese-English) introduction to the cultural significance of the number 5.
- Includes detailed explanations of number 5 in Chinese philosophy (Five Elements, Five Constants, etc.) and its Western cultural associations.
- Provides a comprehensive profile of Chen Lang and his OpenClaw project matrix.
- Lists modern and traditional applications/symbolisms of the number 5.
- Usage guide for question types supported by this skill.
